# Stitch Export

> Stitch Export is a free, open-source Chrome extension for Google Stitch that exports every project — screens, images, design systems and the full chat history — to ZIP archives and LLM-ready JSON (Claude, ChatGPT), locally in your browser.

## What it does

- Export All Projects: one ZIP with every Stitch project (screens/, history/turn-NNN-*/, design-systems/*.md, chat.json, conversation.<format>.json).
- Export This Project (ZIP): the same for the open project, plus a full-size picture of every HTML screen.
- Export Conversation: the chat as JSON only, in Claude Code, OpenAI ChatGPT or custom-role format.
- Runs in the background; closing the popup does not stop it. Keep the background Stitch tab open.
- Uses Stitch's own web API from your logged-in tab. Nothing is sent to any third-party server.

## Install

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/stitch-export/epmhicnoeiapmnobjhlliadbafbkdmag
- Or load the repository folder unpacked via chrome://extensions (Developer Mode).
